segments.ja: 帰国の翌朝も、ライナーの夜は閉じていません。閉じていない理由は、母の家の天井が、島の天井に変わる、です。変わるたびに、彼はベルトルトの名を飲み込みます。飲み込む音を、隣の部屋の候補たちは聞きません。聞かない朝に、ガビはまだ点数の話をしています。している明るさが、ライナーには扉の向こうの騒音です。騒音を、彼は英雄の顔で受けられません。
segments.en: The morning after the return, Reiner's night is still not closed. The reason it is not closed is that the ceiling of his mother's house keeps turning into the ceiling on the island. Each time it turns, he swallows Bertholdt's name. The candidates in the next room do not hear the sound of swallowing. On the morning they do not hear it, Gabi is still talking about points. The brightness of that talk is, for Reiner, noise beyond a door. He cannot receive the noise with a hero's face.

segments.en: Porco looks at Reiner as the side that inherited the Jaw Titan. The reason he looks is that his brother Marcel did not return from the island, and that power came to him. He calls the path it came by Reiner's failure. Pieck is in the room, in a posture close to the floor. She does not let the argument run long. In place of letting it, she leaves only the fact. The fact she leaves is that the warriors who came back from the island are fewer than the number who went. The candidates do not yet know the few seats as empty chairs.

segments.en: At the edge of the meeting, Zeke's name comes out once. The name that comes out is the current holder of the Beast Titan, and Marley's lead warrior. This episode does not open the whole of the lead warrior's plan. The reason it does not open it is that Reiner himself does not hold the details. Without holding them, he knows a return expedition to the island is near. The nearness he knows hurries the candidates' inheritance. Inside the air that hurries it, Gabi believes she will be chosen. Falco thinks the seat she believes in is a different door.

segments.en: Falco goes as an errand boy to the ward of wounded Eldian soldiers. The reason he goes is that it counts as a candidate's service. segments.en: Kruger trusts Falco with a bundle of letters. The address he trusts them to is outside the internment zone. Taking them outside is dangerous under the candidates' rules. The man calls the danger a work of hope. The hope he names is to deliver them to people who might shorten the war. Falco does not read the contents he would deliver. In place of reading, he begins to think this might be a road that helps Gabi. Beginning to think that is the handle of this door. The handle is still small.

segments.ja: ファルコは、腕章を気にしながら区の外の箱へ手紙を入れます。入れる手が、一度止まります。止まる理由は、これが裏切りに見える、です。見える恐れより、ガビが巨人の寿命を受ける恐れが勝ります。勝った足が、箱の口を閉じます。閉じたあと、彼はクルーガーのもとへ戻ります。戻った報告は、短いです。短い報告を、男は礼で受けます。受ける礼が、ファルコには大人の承認に感じられます。
segments.en: Minding the armband, Falco puts the letters into a box outside the zone. The hand that puts them in stops once. The reason it stops is that this looks like betrayal. The fear of Gabi receiving a Titan's lifespan wins over the fear that can be seen. The feet that won close the mouth of the box. After it closes, he returns to Kruger. The report of the return is short. The man receives the short report with thanks. The thanks he receives feel, to Falco, like an adult's approval.

segments.en: Reiner notices that Falco's trips outside have increased. The eyes that notice have watched companions' lies on the island. Even with the eyes that have watched, he does not stop the boy at once. The reason he does not stop him is that he does not want to crush the boy's hope with his own nightmare. The wish not to crush it and a sense of danger are there at the same time. He does not tell his mother both that are there. On the night he does not tell, he sees again the scene where Bertholdt died. The scene he sees is a room with the door left open.

segments.ja: ガビは、ファルコの外出を奉仕の点数だと思っています。思っている彼女は、自分の記録のほうが上だと繰り返します。繰り返す競争を、ファルコはもう受けません。受けない理由は、勝つことが彼女を巨人にする、です。にする競争から降りることが、彼の扉です。扉の説明を、彼はまだガビにできません。できないまま、彼は彼女のパンを分けます。分ける手が、今夜の優しさです。
segments.en: Gabi thinks Falco's trips outside are service points. She, thinking that, repeats that her own record is higher. Falco no longer accepts the competition she repeats. The reason he does not accept it is that winning makes her a Titan. Stepping down from the competition that does that is his door. He still cannot explain the door to Gabi. Without being able to, he shares her bread. The hand that shares is tonight's kindness.

segments.en: Pieck opens a little of the talk of empty seats to the candidates. The talk she opens is that Marcel disappeared before Falco's generation. After he disappeared, Porco holds the Jaw. The anger he holds is the root of the contempt toward Reiner. Falco lays that root over his brother Colt's face. The imagination he lays over it is himself after Gabi inherits a seat. segments.ja: 次に棟を訪れたとき、クルーガーは新しい手紙を渡しません。渡さない代わりに、ファルコの家族の話を聞きます。聞く姿勢は、士官ではなく、隣のベッドです。ベッドの男は、島の子供たちの年齢を知っているように見えます。見える知識を、彼は自慢しません。自慢しない静けさが、ファルコの信頼を深くします。深くした信頼が、希望の扉の蝶番です。蝶番は、まだ誰の家のものか分かっていません。
segments.en: The next time he visits the ward, Kruger does not hand over a new letter. In place of handing one over, he listens to the talk of Falco's family. The posture of listening is not an officer's. It is the next bed. The man in the bed looks as if he knows the ages of the children on the island. He does not boast of the knowledge that can be seen. The quiet of not boasting deepens Falco's trust. The deepened trust is the hinge of the door of hope. The hinge does not yet know whose house it belongs to.

segments.en: For Reiner, the door is not the letters. It is not. It is the room on the island that could not be closed. In the room are Bertholdt, a boy from his class, and the lie he himself told. segments.en: On the night he closed the box, Falco looks at his hand once more. The hand he looks at may be a hand of betrayal, and it may be a hand of rescue. He holds both of the mays beside Gabi's sleeping breath. The choice he holds has not gone back. The letter that has not gone back is in someone's hand. He does not know the destination it has passed to. Not knowing is the fear inside hope. Still in the fear, the lamps of the internment zone increase with preparation for the festival.
